description: Add a sending domain and/or check its DNS. First call registers the domain and returns the DNS records (ownership TXT, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, tracking) for the user to install. Call again after they are installed to run a live DNS check — the domain becomes `verified` once ownership + DKIM + SPF resolve. Safe to call repeatedly.
name: volanea_setup_domain

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

dnsRecords.description: The exact records to add — DKIM, SPF and tracking.

status.description: pending until DNS verifies. Sending from an unverified domain is refused.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
